name: Front
one_liner: Front is a customer communication / shared-inbox helpdesk platform with a REST API for managing conversations, messages, contacts, and workflow automation.
auto_notes: pass1/pass2 disagree on access (paid_plan vs self_serve_free)

evidence.quote: You'll get access to a free developer environment that will provide everything you need to begin building with our APIs.
The Core API uses Bearer tokens to authenticate its user. You MUST send the token for each request in the Authorization header.
Front recommends implementing OAuth when feasible, which has the additional benefit of building within our application framework.
Front's MCP server (mcp.frontapp.com/mcp) lets AI agents act on Front conversation data using a single OAuth-authenticated endpoint.
You'll get access to a free developer environment that will provide everything you need to begin building with our APIs.
REST API designed to communicate using JSON for request and response handling.
Unauthenticated probe -> HTTP 401; WWW-Authenticate: None; body: {"_error":{"status":401,"title":"Unauthenticated","message":"JSON Web Token error"}}

notes: Front provides a free developer sandbox account (limited to 3 teammates) for building against its REST Core API, with both API-token and OAuth2 authentication (both transmitted as Bearer tokens). OAuth is required/recommended for public integrations distributed to other Front customers, but a developer can self-serve an API token immediately for building/testing without sales contact. Front also ships an official vendor-published MCP server (open beta, OAuth 2.1+PKCE, mcp.frontapp.com/mcp) exposing conversations, messages, contacts, tags, etc.
